documentation_note: These thresholds are provisional engineering interpretations formulated from DMI/AGMARK (Directorate of Marketing & Inspection, Government of India) Tomato Grading and Marking Rules and UNECE Standard FFV-36. They provide an objective, transparent benchmark for market negotiations and require formal field validation against certified mandi grader evaluations.

color_stages.description: Completely green surface with mature green sheen
Definite break in color from green to tannish-yellow, pink, or red on not more than 10% of surface
10% to 30% of surface shows aggregate red or pink coloration
30% to 60% of surface shows aggregate red or pink coloration
60% to 90% of surface shows red coloration
More than 90% of surface shows intense red coloration

Extra.description: Superior quality, virtually free of superficial defects, well-formed, uniform color

Class I.description: Good quality, minor superficial skin defects up to 3% surface area, slight shape irregularity allowed

Class II.description: Marketable quality, minor defects up to 8% surface area, greenback allowed provided fruit remains firm

Below standard.description: Fruit exceeding defect thresholds (>8% defects), severely misshapen, undersized, or showing cracks/decay

Extra.description: Maximum 5% by number of fruit not satisfying requirements of Extra class

Class I.description: Maximum 10% by number of fruit not satisfying requirements of Class I

Class II.description: Maximum 10% by number of fruit not satisfying requirements of Class II
